requirements.text: This role is 100% remote within the United States, with Pacific Time availability strongly preferred. The engagement is expected to continue through December 2027, with potential for extension. You will support researchers, hardware engineers, infrastructure teams, engineering lab owners, and GPU service teams within a highly technical production engineering environment.
Senior-level experience as a Product Data Scientist, Product Analyst, or similar analytics professional.
Experience building metrics, goals, and reporting frameworks for a new or previously unmeasured product or platform.
Advanced SQL experience with large-scale data warehouses.
Strong Python skills for analysis and automation using pandas or similar libraries.
Experience defining metric layers, dashboards, and reusable reporting in partnership with data engineering.
Applied statistical knowledge for sound inference and experiment-adjacent reasoning.
Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to influence Senior technical leaders.
Customer-focused mindset with the ability to connect technical measurements to business and user outcomes.
Comfort working independently in an ambiguous environment without an established playbook.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development and analytics tools.
Experience with hardware, silicon, GPU or compute services, engineering labs, or research infrastructure.
Experience supporting production engineering, infrastructure, platform, or internal technical products.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or a similar dashboarding platform.
